import unittest

from order import Order, cancel_order


class CancelOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_s1_owner_cancels_unshipped_order(self):
        order = Order(order_id="order-1", owner_id="alice", status="unshipped")

        result = cancel_order(order, "alice")

        self.assertIs(result, True)
        self.assertEqual(order, Order("order-1", "alice", "cancelled"))

    def test_s2_different_owner_and_order_can_cancel(self):
        order = Order(order_id="order-27", owner_id="carol", status="unshipped")

        result = cancel_order(order, "carol")

        self.assertIs(result, True)
        self.assertEqual(order, Order("order-27", "carol", "cancelled"))

    def test_s3_non_owner_is_rejected_without_changes(self):
        order = Order(order_id="order-1", owner_id="alice", status="unshipped")
        before = Order(order.order_id, order.owner_id, order.status)

        result = cancel_order(order, "bob")

        with self.subTest("return value"):
            self.assertIs(result, False)
        with self.subTest("order remains unchanged"):
            self.assertEqual(order, before)

    def test_s4_shipped_order_is_rejected_without_changes(self):
        order = Order(order_id="order-1", owner_id="alice", status="shipped")
        before = Order(order.order_id, order.owner_id, order.status)

        result = cancel_order(order, "alice")

        with self.subTest("return value"):
            self.assertIs(result, False)
        with self.subTest("order remains unchanged"):
            self.assertEqual(order, before)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
